entries.en: The reality is that the repairs will take another month.
entries.zh: 实际情况是，维修工作还需要一个月。

entries.en: We planted two small apple trees in the yard behind our house.
entries.zh: 我们在屋后的院子里种了两棵小苹果树。

entries.en: The school teaches students how to resolve disagreements without violence.
entries.zh: 学校教学生如何在不使用暴力的情况下解决分歧。

entries.meaningZh: 一起参与某项活动的搭档
entries.en: My project partner checked the calculations while I prepared the charts.
entries.zh: 我准备图表时，项目搭档检查了计算过程。

entries.en: A reliable water supply is essential for every village in the region.
entries.zh: 稳定的供水对这个地区的每个村庄都至关重要。

entries.en: The smell of fresh bread drifted from the kitchen into the hallway.
entries.zh: 新鲜面包的香味从厨房飘进了走廊。

entries.meaningZh: 购买商品或服务的消费者
entries.en: The new label helps each consumer compare the energy use of appliances.
entries.zh: 新标签帮助消费者比较各种电器的耗电量。

entries.en: A bright painting of the harbour hangs above the reception desk.
entries.zh: 接待台上方挂着一幅色彩明快的海港画作。

entries.en: The scientist repeated the experiment before sharing the surprising result.
entries.zh: 这位科学家在公布这个出人意料的结果前，重复进行了实验。

entries.en: Sharing the equipment offered a practical solution to our budget problem.
entries.zh: 共用设备为我们的预算问题提供了一个切实可行的解决办法。

entries.meaningZh: 受到灾难或伤害影响的人
entries.en: The charity helped each victim find a safe place to stay.
entries.zh: 慈善机构帮助每位受害者找到安全的住处。

entries.en: The local newspaper published a photograph of our community garden.
entries.zh: 当地报纸刊登了一张我们社区花园的照片。

entries.en: Loose rocks posed a threat to walkers on the narrow path.
entries.zh: 松动的岩石对走在狭窄小路上的行人构成了威胁。

entries.en: In my opinion, the smaller room is better for group discussions.
entries.zh: 在我看来，较小的房间更适合小组讨论。

entries.en: Please bring your notes tomorrow so we can compare our answers.
entries.zh: 请明天带上你的笔记，这样我们就能比较各自的答案。

entries.en: Taking an earlier train is our best option if the road closes.
entries.zh: 如果公路封闭，乘坐更早的一班火车是我们最好的选择。

entries.meaningZh: 对某项计划或意见的反对
entries.en: The proposal faced strong opposition from residents near the airport.
entries.zh: 这项提议遭到了机场附近居民的强烈反对。

entries.en: After several unsuccessful attempts, we eventually found a working connection.
entries.zh: 几次尝试失败后，我们终于成功连接上了。

entries.meaningZh: 某一次特定的时刻或场合
entries.en: On one occasion, the whole team stayed late to finish the display.
entries.zh: 有一次，整个团队都留下来加班，把展陈做完。

entries.en: The training course is highly practical and includes several workshop sessions.
entries.zh: 这门培训课程实践性很强，包含几次实操课。

entries.en: The rescue team's mission was to reach the village before nightfall.
entries.zh: 救援队的任务是在天黑前到达那个村庄。

entries.en: Our target is to repair fifty donated bicycles by the end of June.
entries.zh: 我们的目标是在六月底前修好五十辆捐赠的自行车。

entries.en: Her short speech thanked the volunteers who had kept the library open.
entries.zh: 她在简短的讲话中感谢了让图书馆得以继续开放的志愿者。

entries.en: The southern entrance remains open while workers repair the main gate.
entries.zh: 工人维修大门期间，南面的入口仍然开放。

entries.en: The instructor shared a video showing how to adjust the microscope.
entries.zh: 老师分享了一段演示如何调节显微镜的视频。

entries.en: The second route is slightly longer but has much less traffic.
entries.zh: 第二条路线稍长一些，但车流量小得多。

entries.en: The proposed reform would make the application process easier to understand.
entries.zh: 拟议中的改革将使申请流程更容易理解。

entries.en: We found a quiet restaurant beside the station and ordered soup.
entries.zh: 我们在车站旁找到一家安静的餐馆，点了汤。

entries.meaningZh: 中午之后至傍晚的时间
entries.en: The students spent the afternoon measuring water quality at the lake.
entries.zh: 学生们用一个下午的时间测量了湖水的水质。

entries.en: We need to review the safety instructions before using the new machine.
entries.zh: 使用新机器之前，我们需要重新检查安全操作说明。

entries.en: I can recall the conversation, but I cannot remember the exact date.
entries.zh: 我能回想起那次谈话，却记不清确切的日期。

entries.meaningZh: 免受危险或伤害的状态
entries.en: For everyone's safety, please keep the emergency exit clear at all times.
entries.zh: 为保障大家的安全，请始终保持紧急出口畅通。

entries.en: Save a copy of your work; otherwise, a power cut could erase it.
entries.zh: 保存一份工作成果的副本，否则停电可能使它丢失。

entries.en: The room was so crowded that we could hardly reach the door.
entries.zh: 房间里挤满了人，我们几乎走不到门口。

entries.en: Please write your contact details below the name of your department.
entries.zh: 请把你的联系方式写在院系名称的下方。

entries.meaningZh: 某事在当前阶段的状态
entries.en: You can check the status of your order on the delivery page.
entries.zh: 你可以在配送页面查看订单的当前状态。

entries.meaningZh: 一队士兵、骑兵或童子军
entries.en: The scout troop practised putting up tents before the weekend trip.
entries.zh: 这个童子军小队在周末出行前练习了搭帐篷。

entries.en: A clear introduction helps the reader understand why the question matters.
entries.zh: 清晰的引言能帮助读者理解这个问题为什么重要。

entries.en: We must be absolutely certain that everyone has left the building.
entries.zh: 我们必须完全确定所有人都已离开大楼。

entries.en: Our plane landed early, leaving enough time to catch the last bus.
entries.zh: 我们的飞机提前降落了，因此还来得及赶上末班公交车。

entries.en: Nobody noticed the missing sign until a visitor asked for directions.
entries.zh: 直到一位访客问路，才有人注意到那块标牌不见了。

entries.en: Try reading the entire sentence before looking up the unfamiliar word.
entries.zh: 查不认识的单词之前，先试着读完整个句子。

entries.en: I kept a printed copy of the timetable in my bag.
entries.zh: 我在包里放了一份打印出来的时刻表。

entries.en: The class compared nuclear energy with solar and wind power.
entries.zh: 全班比较了核能与太阳能、风能。

entries.meaningZh: 体育比赛的联赛或联盟
entries.en: Our school entered a local basketball league for the first time.
entries.zh: 我们学校第一次参加了当地的篮球联赛。

entries.meaningZh: 临时住宿和活动的营地
entries.en: The walking group reached camp just before the heavy rain began.
entries.zh: 徒步小组赶在大雨开始前抵达了营地。

entries.meaningZh: 艺术家或创作者的工作室
entries.en: The artist opened her studio to visitors during the neighbourhood festival.
entries.zh: 邻里节期间，这位艺术家向访客开放了她的工作室。

entries.en: We spent the weekend repairing the fence around the community garden.
entries.zh: 我们利用周末修好了社区花园周围的围栏。

entries.en: Please buy a dozen eggs if the shop still has any.
entries.zh: 如果店里还有鸡蛋，请买一打。

entries.en: Better public transport would help people reach the hospital without driving.
entries.zh: 更完善的公共交通能让人们不开车也能到达医院。

entries.meaningZh: 收藏和展出文物等的博物馆
entries.en: The museum displays tools that were once used in local factories.
entries.zh: 这家博物馆展出了过去当地工厂使用过的工具。

entries.meaningZh: 两个相配或一起使用的东西
entries.en: She left a spare pair of gloves beside the garden tools.
entries.zh: 她在园艺工具旁放了一副备用手套。

entries.en: The club's annual meeting gives members a chance to suggest new activities.
entries.zh: 俱乐部的年度会议让会员有机会提出新的活动建议。

entries.en: Her calm presence helped the nervous students settle before the performance.
entries.zh: 她镇定地陪在现场，让紧张的学生们在表演前安定下来。

entries.meaningZh: 运送人员或货物的大船
entries.en: The research ship returned to port with samples from the seabed.
entries.zh: 这艘科考船带着海底样本返回了港口。

entries.meaningZh: 防止伤害或损坏的保护
entries.en: The cover provides protection from dust while the equipment is stored.
entries.zh: 设备存放期间，这个罩子可以起到防尘保护作用。

entries.en: In the story, the queen listens carefully to the villagers' concerns.
entries.zh: 故事中，女王认真听取村民们的担忧。

entries.en: We tied the boat to the wooden post beside the landing.
entries.zh: 我们把小船系在靠岸处旁的一根木柱上。

entries.meaningZh: 用于制造或燃烧的木材
entries.en: This shelf is made from wood recovered from an old workshop.
entries.zh: 这个架子是用从一家旧作坊回收的木材做成的。

entries.en: Clouds covered the mountain before we reached the final section of the trail.
entries.zh: 还没走到步道的最后一段，云层就遮住了山峰。

entries.en: New patterns emerge when we compare the results from different groups.
entries.zh: 比较不同小组的结果时，新的规律会逐渐显现。

entries.en: The regional bus network connects small towns with the main railway station.
entries.zh: 这个地区的公交网络将各个小镇与主要火车站连接起来。

entries.en: Each resident received a letter explaining the changes to rubbish collection.
entries.zh: 每位居民都收到了一封说明垃圾收集安排变更的信。

entries.meaningZh: 尚未充分发展的能力或可能性
entries.en: The empty hall has the potential to become a useful study space.
entries.zh: 这座空大厅有潜力改造成实用的学习空间。

entries.en: The warning sign explains the danger of walking on the frozen lake.
entries.zh: 警示牌说明了在结冰的湖面上行走的危险。

entries.en: Comparing my weekly recordings helped me notice the progress in my pronunciation.
entries.zh: 对比自己每周的录音，帮助我注意到了发音上的进步。

entries.en: Her first reaction was to check whether anyone needed immediate help.
entries.zh: 她的第一反应是查看是否有人需要立即得到帮助。

entries.en: A small crowd gathered outside the bakery as the musicians began playing.
entries.zh: 乐手开始演奏时，一小群人聚集在了面包店外。

entries.en: Several neighbours were willing to help us carry the heavy shelves upstairs.
entries.zh: 几位邻居愿意帮我们把沉重的架子搬上楼。

entries.meaningZh: 表达意见的评论或话语
entries.en: One helpful comment from my tutor made the argument much clearer.
entries.zh: 导师的一条有帮助的意见，使这段论证清楚了许多。

entries.en: The novel follows a teacher who runs reading classes inside a prison.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位在监狱内开设阅读课的教师的故事。

entries.en: We received a polite reply explaining why the room was unavailable.
entries.zh: 我们收到了一封礼貌的回复，说明那间房为什么无法使用。

entries.meaningZh: 采访和报道新闻的记者
entries.en: The reporter interviewed several shopkeepers about the closure of the bridge.
entries.zh: 记者就桥梁封闭一事采访了几位店主。

entries.meaningZh: 运送人员或货物的车辆
entries.en: Only one vehicle can cross the narrow bridge at a time.
entries.zh: 这座窄桥一次只能通过一辆车。

entries.en: The restaurant serves a local wine made from grapes grown nearby.
entries.zh: 这家餐馆供应一种用附近种植的葡萄酿成的当地葡萄酒。

entries.en: I propose that we test the simpler design before ordering more materials.
entries.zh: 我建议在订购更多材料之前，先测试较简单的设计。

entries.en: The missing cable is possibly in the box beside the printer.
entries.zh: 找不到的那根线可能在打印机旁边的盒子里。

entries.en: The improvement was largely due to better planning rather than extra funding.
entries.zh: 这次改善主要归功于更好的规划，而不是额外的资金。

entries.meaningZh: 在困难或危险后继续存在
entries.en: These plants can survive a short period without water during cool weather.
entries.zh: 在凉爽的天气里，这些植物可以在短时间缺水的情况下存活。

entries.en: The telephone rang just as we were leaving for the station.
entries.zh: 我们正要出发去车站时，电话响了。

entries.en: The reading group aims to promote discussion between students from different courses.
entries.zh: 这个读书小组旨在促进修读不同课程的学生之间的讨论。

entries.en: A small package arrived with the replacement parts for our coffee machine.
entries.zh: 一个小包裹送到了，里面装着我们咖啡机的替换零件。

entries.en: A colleague showed me a quicker way to organise the survey responses.
entries.zh: 一位同事向我展示了整理问卷回复的一种更快捷的方法。

entries.en: The workshop is mainly for beginners, but experienced writers are welcome too.
entries.zh: 这个工作坊主要面向初学者，但也欢迎有经验的写作者参加。

entries.en: Keep the seedlings in a warm room until the first leaves appear.
entries.zh: 把幼苗放在温暖的房间里，直到长出第一批叶子。

entries.en: The theatre critic praised the acting but found the final scene confusing.
entries.zh: 这位剧评人称赞了演员的表演，但觉得最后一幕令人费解。

entries.en: The ticket costs twenty dollars plus a small online booking fee.
entries.zh: 票价是二十元，另加一小笔网上订票费。

entries.en: Please lower the volume so the people beside us can concentrate.
entries.zh: 请把音量调低，让旁边的人能集中注意力。

entries.meaningZh: 表格、名单或词典中的一条记录
entries.en: Each entry in the vocabulary list includes a meaning and a useful example.
entries.zh: 词汇表中的每个词条都包含释义和一个实用例句。

entries.meaningZh: 有柜门或抽屉的储物柜
entries.en: The spare batteries are in the small cabinet beside the window.
entries.zh: 备用电池放在窗户旁边的小柜子里。

entries.en: The detective novel opens with an investigation into a mysterious murder.
entries.zh: 这部侦探小说以调查一起神秘的谋杀案开篇。

entries.meaningZh: 审核和修改稿件的编辑
entries.en: The editor suggested a shorter title and asked for clearer explanations.
entries.zh: 编辑建议把标题缩短，并要求把解释写得更清楚。

entries.en: The path became extremely slippery after the temperature dropped overnight.
entries.zh: 夜间气温下降后，小路变得极其湿滑。

entries.en: Repeated flooding could threaten the future of several small farms.
entries.zh: 反复发生的洪水可能危及几家小农场的未来。

entries.meaningZh: 焦虑或痛苦减轻后的宽慰
entries.en: It was a relief to hear that everyone had reached home safely.
entries.zh: 听说大家都已平安到家，我们松了一口气。

entries.meaningZh: 承诺投入时间、资源或资金
entries.en: Before we commit more time to the project, we need clearer goals.
entries.zh: 在为这个项目投入更多时间之前，我们需要更明确的目标。

entries.meaningZh: 不同寻常而令人觉得奇怪的
entries.en: A strange noise from the washing machine made us stop the cycle.
entries.zh: 洗衣机发出一种奇怪的声音，我们便停止了洗涤程序。

entries.meaningZh: 年轻时的时期；青年时代
entries.en: In her youth, my grandmother travelled to work by bicycle every day.
entries.zh: 年轻时，我祖母每天骑自行车去上班。

entries.meaningZh: 让人感到非常愉快或赞叹的
entries.en: The balcony offers a wonderful view of the river at sunset.
entries.zh: 日落时，从阳台可以欣赏到河上美妙的景色。

entries.meaningZh: 参观或游览某处的行程
entries.en: A volunteer gave us a short tour of the restored railway station.
entries.zh: 一位志愿者带我们简短参观了修复后的火车站。
